The earlier example: illegal hunting of black water chicken (200+ birds) was labeled "非法狩猎". So we should use same label: "非法狩猎". The fact also includes selling, but the charge is about illegal hunting. The list also includes "非法狩猎". So answer: [罪名]非法狩猎<eoa>.
